correctness.rationale: PASS: Under f>0 on (0,1), the exact sampled intensity μ_h=max_{[0,1]}(Φ_h(x)-x) follows from the prior scalar barrier theorem and can be reconstructed by upper/lower invariant barriers. Choosing a point on the flow half-way between endpoints proves μ_h→1; hence any maximizer x_h→0 and y_h=Φ_h(x_h)→1. Autonomous scalar flow derivative Φ_h'(x)=f(Φ_h(x))/f(x); at any interior maximum f(x_h)=f(y_h), so λx_h~ν(1-y_h). Time coordinates T(Φ_h(x))-T(x)=h with convergent C2 endpoint logarithmic renormalizations then give κ=λν/(λ+ν), x_h~(ν/(λ+ν))C_f exp(-κh) and 1-y_h~(λ/(λ+ν))C_f exp(-κh). Their sum is 1-μ_h. Checked logistic exact μ_h=tanh(h/4), scaled gap→2; cubic exact gap scaled exp(2h/3)→3/2, agreeing with the stated C_f. No uniqueness assumption or finite numerical inference of general asymptotics is used.
